origin.ikari.ikari.name: Ikari
origin.ikari.ikari.description: Ikari are carnivorous bird people. They hunt by flying low, weaving through obstacles to catch their prey.
power.ikari.wings.name: Wings!
power.ikari.wings.description:
Your wings let you fly under your own power at low altitudes.

You need to stay light to fly fast, so heavy armor slows you down considerably.
power.ikari.hollow_bones.name: Hollow Bones
power.ikari.hollow_bones.description:
Ikari evolved hollow bones, much like a bird's, so they could fly.

That lightness leaves them far more fragile.
power.ikari.icarus.name: Icarus
power.ikari.icarus.description: Fly too close to the sun and your wings burn up.
power.ikari.flimsy.name: Flimsy
power.ikari.flimsy.description: If you get wet or catch fire, your wings stop working for a little while.
power.ikari.carnivore.name: Carnivore
power.ikari.carnivore.description: You can only eat meat. Vegetables are inedible to you.
power.ikari.aerial_combatant.name: Aerial Combatant
power.ikari.aerial_combatant.description: While you glide with an Elytra, your attacks hit much harder.
